entities.name: CD34 antigen
observations: The 412-residue query sequence is a strong homolog of vertebrate CD34; human CD34 UniProt P28906 alignment identity is 68.7% with 80.6% query coverage and E-value 2.26e-131.
The sequence contains an N-terminal signal peptide-like region, a heavily glycosylated low-complexity extracellular region, a single hydrophobic transmembrane segment, and a cytoplasmic tail.
The query contains Pfam CD34_antigen domain PF06365.18 at residues 188-350.
CD34 is a possible adhesion molecule involved in early hematopoiesis and presentation of carbohydrate ligands to selectins; exact activity remains partly inferred from homology.
Reference CD34 proteins are annotated at the plasma membrane, external side of plasma membrane, and extracellular region.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, homology, Pfam domain, function, localization, and GO evidence

entities.name: Human CD34
observations: UniProt P28906 is a reviewed single-pass type I membrane protein with signal peptide residues 1-31, extracellular region 32-290, transmembrane helix 291-311, and cytoplasmic region 312-385.
Human CD34 is annotated as a possible adhesion molecule and scaffold for lineage-specific glycans, presenting carbohydrate ligands to selectins.
Associated biological processes include cell-cell adhesion, cell motility, and early hematopoietic stem/progenitor-cell attachment.
